problems.title: Valid Parenthesis String
problems.keyInsight: Track min and max possible open count. '*' can be '(', ')' or empty. Valid if min ever drops below 0, clamp to 0. At end, min must be 0.

code.python:
def checkValidString(s):
    lo = hi = 0  # range of possible open parens
    for c in s:
        if c == '(': lo += 1; hi += 1
        elif c == ')': lo -= 1; hi -= 1
        else: lo -= 1; hi += 1  # * can be (, ), or ""
        if hi < 0: return False
        lo = max(lo, 0)
    return lo == 0
